claims.claim: Body07 does not justify replacing body05
claims.reason: Fullbird remains a regular tiled shell; candidate introduces bright squared cervical tabs and regular long chest leaves rather than source connected irregular regional armor.

claims.claim: Attempt02 improves compactness over attempt01 but not enough source resemblance
claims.reason: Shortened rounded tips remove the worst long hanging flare; conspicuous rows, stepping roots and upper shield interruption remain.

claims.claim: Repeated procedural leaf approach fails macro source partition
claims.type: causal inference from code and pixels
claims.reason: Regular row/column sampling, a shared normalized leaf outline and guide-derived tangent directions produce broad uniform courses. Shape is determined before individual source boundaries are authored. Neighbor gap fitting cannot recover the source composition.

Upper lateral shoulder/channel junction remains interrupted; extended edge-line fitting is not an occlusion/depth solution. Its computed intersection is not used as a shared reconstructed surface, and lateral flare redistributes edges without validating regional mask coverage.

claims.claim: Original geometry and UV preservation establishes likeness
claims.reason: Readback checks are separate preservation evidence; visible failure remains decisive. Reviewer did not rerun native digest or Blender tests.

visual_findings: Source shoulder is a compact backward/downward teardrop with fine coverts flowing into longer outer leaves; it is not a spherical shell of equally ranked horizontal rows.
Source breast combines fitted curved irregular armor and readable mechanical channels; candidate repeats large pointed scallops in orderly rows across the chest.
Attempt02 grazing clay shows rectangular neck root shelves and angular crossing joins, not continuous cervical-to-breast plate flow.
Receiving metal05 makes exposed root tabs and upper sheet rims visibly pale; material changes cannot resolve the geometry composition defect.
Side and rear candidate views retain the bulbous uniformly clad envelope. Rear design is inferred because locked source supplies no rear truth.
Turntable images show body/neck from eight angles but crop head and feet in several views; use whole-bird PBR/clay frames for overall identity and require uncropped next turntable evidence.

next_operator.name: source-partition hero-sheet authoring
next_operator.owner: one fresh armor author; architect owns integration and QC
next_operator.input: Exact completed06 receiving native above; retain body05 and metal05; no body07 application
next_operator.first_action: At frozen camera04, manually trace the locked composite outer shoulder teardrop, covert cap boundary, lower shield free-tip arc, cervical armor edges, breast lobes and purposeful machinery-corridor border as named editable 2D Bezier paths. Store source pixel coordinates and label ambiguous depth as proposal.
next_operator.construction: Lift each traced regional path into an independent shallow curved 3D sheet using a few hand-placed control points over the receiving geometry as positional context. Author unique low-resolution cages and deliberate overlap order region by region. Use body05 as backing and preserve useful small leaves, replacing visibility only for selected superseded body05 patches. No row/column generator, globally shared leaf profile, envelope retile or automatic blanket mirroring.
next_operator.first_scope: Near visible shoulder outer contour plus cervical/breast transition only. Author roughly 8-16 hero sheets total as an execution bound, not an acceptance metric: covert cap/border, 3-5 longer lower shield sheets and 3-5 fitted breast/cervical plates with locally varied silhouette and stagger. Add no fasteners or microdetail until macro partition visibly improves.
next_operator.depth_order: Write an explicit named above/below adjacency list per selected patch; control overlap in camera04 then inspect grazing/front/side views to remove visible root tabs and crossings. Close accidental armor gaps selectively with covered portions of these sheets; keep documented machinery corridor open.
next_operator.geometry_protection: Do not edit, delete, transform, reparent, remesh, re-UV, or overwrite any original geometry, material graph/map, vertex color, anchor or pose. New meshes/cages and UVs are separate versioned proposal objects. Reversible render hiding is allowed only for named selected body05 armor patches; record visibility manifest. Head, stance, legs, feet and machinery untouched.
next_operator.materials: Use exact receiving semantic material graphs and proper new normalized local UVs; preserve packed originals. No finish/lighting adjustments to hide seams. Surface transfer can be addressed separately after shape passes.
next_operator.checkpoint: One source/receiving/candidate fullbird metal and clay comparison within 15 minutes, identical estimated camera04 and lighting; provide regional grazing/front/side pairs and uncropped eight-angle turntable before retain decision.
next_operator.budget: 30 minutes hard cap, at most two focused source-partition attempts; stop or change approach after two without visible fullbird gain.
next_operator.acceptance: Visible closer compact shoulder teardrop and regional hierarchy; continuous fitted neck/breast flow without squared roots; machinery corridor readable; no increased flare or crossed sheets in side/grazing. Counts and digest passes cannot substitute for this. Final owner artistic acceptance remains outstanding.
next_operator.excluded: Whole-envelope regeneration, new stance, head edits, added hardware, dependencies, animation, engineering, browser/runtime promotion, publication, paid services.

alternatives.selective_handplaced_hero_sheets: recommended: isolates known visible defects, permits unique source contours/depth order, retains successful body05 backing and receiving materials
alternatives.whole_envelope_regeneration: reject for next increment: forces uncertain hidden-side topology, repeats spherical course generator risk and discards useful regional work before proving one source-facing macro correction. Any later broader rebuild requires separate demonstrated need, preserved inputs and bounded architect task.

No children or repository mutations; only temporary review/contact-sheet artifacts written.
Independent reviewer shares model family and source evidence with other team roles; this is one outcome review, not the complete five-role equilibrium protocol.
